subject: reference-nexus-bot

arrangement.label: left-aligned-text-plus-diagram
arrangement.notes: Text intro paired with a bordered technical diagram block (status rows), not eyebrow-title-cta-stack/fullbleed-media/split-media-text/typographic-only.

textTreatment.label: bracketed-monospace
textTreatment.notes: Labels wrapped in literal brackets, e.g. '[ Ver módulos ]', set in monospace. Not plain uppercase/sentence/mixed-emphasis. Also has two coexisting CTA fill treatments (solid + outline) — same schema limitation noted in reference-alfil.

alternativeStructures.label: bordered-grid-table
alternativeStructures.notes: Modules render in a continuous CSS grid with shared borders and zero gap — reads as one spec-sheet-like structure, not editorial-blocks/timeline/list/collage/discrete cards.

freeformNotes: This is the one probe where 'no photography' is a confident, deliberate 'known: none' rather than an 'unknown' gap — the brand intent explicitly excludes photography in favor of information-as-material.
